definitions.explanation: A shared mail collection area in an apartment building where individual mailboxes for each unit are grouped together, typically near the entrance.

examples.japanese: {集合|しゅうごう}ポストを{確認|かくにん}した。
{集合|しゅうごう}ポストに{郵便|ゆうびん}が{届|とど}いていた。
examples.english: There was mail in the communal mailbox.

examples.japanese: {集合|しゅうごう}ポストの{鍵|かぎ}を{忘|わす}れてしまった。

notes:
{集合|しゅうごう}ポスト is standard in Japanese apartment buildings. Each unit has its own locked mailbox within the communal area, which is usually located near the building entrance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集合|しゅうごう}ポストの{鍵|かぎ} (mailbox key)
- {集合|しゅうごう}ポストを{開|あ}ける (to open the mailbox)
- {集合|しゅうごう}ポストエリア (mailbox area)

RELATED TERMS:
- {郵便|ゆうびん}ポスト: mailbox (for sending)
- {郵便|ゆうびん}{受|う}け: mail slot
- {宅配|たくはい}ボックス: delivery locker
